table.UNDERSTOOD_MAIL_ASK: answer about {which} (a model reads that e-mail in an isolated run, up to US$ {cap})
table.UNDERSTOOD_MAIL_SUMMARY: summarize {which}, because showing the original text is not enabled here (a model reads that e-mail in an isolated run, up to US$ {cap})
table.MA_NOT_BUILT: I cannot answer questions about e-mails yet: the reader is not installed.
table.MA_NOT_PROVEN: I cannot answer questions about e-mails yet: the reader has not passed its first full test.
table.MA_DAY_LIMIT: I already answered {count} questions about e-mails today, which is the limit for a day.
table.MA_DAY_LIMIT_ONE: I already answered 1 question about an e-mail today, which is the limit for a day.
table.MA_BUSY: I am already answering another question; try again in a moment.
table.MA_FAILED: I could not answer about the e-mail now. Try again in a few minutes.
table.MA_TIMEOUT: The question about the e-mail took too long and was stopped.
table.MA_CAP: The question about the e-mail reached its cost limit and was stopped.
table.MA_NOT_FOUND: The e-mail does not hold the answer.
table.MA_NO_TEXT: That e-mail has no text for me to read.
table.MA_WITHHELD: That e-mail looks like it holds a password or a key, so I did not hand it to the reader.
table.MA_LONG: I read only the first 4,000 characters of this e-mail.
table.MA_NUMBER_CHECK: Check this: {values} is not in the e-mail.
table.MA_PICK: Say “summarize {n} from {box}”, with the number and the box of the one you want.
table.MA_WHICH_SAY_ONE: Say “summarize {n} from {box}” to read the one in {box}.
table.MA_CHANGED: The mailbox was read again after you asked, so I did not read anything. Ask again.
